trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Use this trophy as your finish line and work through the other 54 PS5 trophies first. Check the PS5 list for anything still locked, especially the separate 100% completion trophy.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Follow the story objective for Gone Fishing until the game marks the mission finished. The trophy lists no optional objective or medal, so normal story progression is the route.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Follow the main objectives through the Chapter 1 transition. Before advancing, keep a separate save if you want a fallback for optional moments; this chapter award itself lists no special condition.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish the main objectives through the end of Chapter 2. Check the chapter award after the transition; side activities are not listed as prerequisites.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Continue the main story until Chapter 3 is marked complete. You can leave collectible totals for later because this award only checks the chapter milestone.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Advance the story past the end of Chapter 4. Keep a separate save before later story beats for optional choices; no alternate outcome is specified for the chapter award.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the finale through to its completion and check for the gold award afterward. Keep a save before starting the finale as insurance for optional events; the trophy itself specifies no ending choice.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: When Breakfast Run appears in the story, follow its objectives to the mission completion screen. Treat an abandoned or failed attempt as unfinished; the trophy asks for completion only.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Follow The Cartel Heist through the full objective chain and check for the award after the mission ends. The list does not name an approach or optional loot requirement.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Track Child’s Play by mission title and finish its entire objective chain when it appears. No chapter, rating or optional decision is specified.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission called Headliners, rather than stopping after the first objective update. The official list gives no chapter or extra target for this award.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play VCIA Takedown to the mission completion screen. Consider keeping a separate save before VCIA sequences for the unscheduled departure trophy; the list does not confirm that both unlock in this mission.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Follow the objectives for Operation Savage Glory until the full mission is complete. The list gives no special loadout, score or chapter requirement.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use the game’s own completion percentage for this gold and investigate gaps after story, strands, activities and collectibles. Compare the in-game tally before and after cleanup tasks; the trophy list does not define which tasks contribute to 100%.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Build the total to 250 using feats that the game credits as Stunts. If a repeat attempt adds nothing, try a different feat and use the tracked count to judge what qualifies.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one event from each distinct activity category; the starter lists nine categories in all. Note the category after each attempt so several variations of one activity do not mask a missing type.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
Competition kit — tracked count

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Work through the Shooting Range challenge list and revisit any event below gold. The kit notes 42 challenges; keep a list of the ones still below gold instead of replaying events you have already cleared.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
Competition kit — tracked count

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Log Top Fun Drone Race wins by venue, with one win at each of the 14 locations noted in the starter. If a repeat win does not advance the count, move on to a venue without a recorded win.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
Competition kit — tracked count

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races and record the event name or route after each victory. Repeating the same race is practice; the wording calls for different races, and it does not give a venue list.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Look for a fishing challenge explicitly against Cal, then play through until the result credits you with the win. His location and retry rules are not specified, so keep a save before accepting if the encounter looks like a one-off.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Choose an arcade game and play through to its completion result. Leaving after a round or a failed run may not count; the list does not require a particular cabinet or score.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy’s strand through its last job; the first meeting is only a starting point. If the thread goes quiet, check the journal for a follow-up as you progress through Leonida.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Use Kenton’s name to follow the same strand through to its final mission. Mark it complete only after the last mission wraps up; the list gives no location for the first encounter.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Follow Billy’s assignments until you finish the final mission in his strand. If no next objective is visible, check the mission log again after more story progress.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Track eight completed stranger storylines across Leonida. Use Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone as leads from the trophy list, and count closed strands rather than eight individual jobs.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Keep following Randy’s mission thread until its finale clears. Check whether an apparently completed job still leaves a follow-up before counting the chain toward the eight stranger strands.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone’s whole chain and check off its finale when the last job ends. If the next marker has not appeared, return to the strand after advancing other objectives.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Record each successful meditation against its location as you explore Leonida. The kit gives 18 spots; if you have a gap, compare areas you have checked instead of revisiting the same marker repeatedly.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
Competition kit — tracked count

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Find the unique animal objective associated with Bret and complete it as his hunt. The list does not identify the species or site, so use Bret’s in-game objectives to distinguish the target from ordinary wildlife.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Track cards by set and prioritize filling gaps in sets you have already started. The trophy checks three completed sets, so a pile of isolated cards does not establish progress on its own.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Look for the WAiNK interaction as you explore and log the locations where it registers. Aim for 100 credited locations; repeated use at one place does not satisfy a location total.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Use the challenge list to track 50 completed entries and return to any that are easiest to finish during cleanup. Keep this total separate from the all-gold Shooting Range requirement unless the game shows an entry counts for both.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Attempt this while your partner is with you: reach four stars, stay together and keep going until the wanted level clears. A solo escape or a lower heat level will not satisfy the wording; if the setup falls apart, start a fresh partner attempt when available.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Keep your partner with you until all four stars clear. Retry together if you split up.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Line up three shops before your first robbery so you can move directly from one to the next with your partner. Keep the wanted level active through all three; if it clears early, restart the sequence at the next opportunity.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Plan three shops before starting. If the heat clears, begin a new streak.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Keep a log of vehicles that actually advance the discovery count as you travel around Leonida. Aim for 100 credited discoveries; the list does not define whether seeing, entering or driving is the trigger, so check as you go.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: When an in-game encounter offers Combat Focus, wait until five eligible enemies are available before using it. All five must go down during that one activation; retry in another suitable encounter if the window closes early.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Wait for five targets, then use one Combat Focus activation. Retry in a suitable encounter.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Before a story visit to VCIA, keep a separate save and watch for a departure opportunity outside the scheduled route. The list names the airport but no exact trigger or availability; reload the save if the sequence moves on before you can test it.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Save before VCIA visits. Watch for an unscheduled exit before moving on.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhinos reference suggests a vehicle-related opportunity, but the list does not spell out the required action. Keep a separate save when a Rhino first becomes available and check the in-game prompts before finishing the encounter.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Save before a Rhino encounter; the exact trigger is unknown.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Plan the jewelry robbery around avoiding detection from start to finish. Keep a separate save if possible before entering; if you get spotted, restart or reload rather than relying on losing the alert afterward.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Save before the robbery. Restart or reload if you get spotted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Plan for the getaway as part of each vault robbery and count it only after you escape. The trophy requires five vaults; log distinct successful sites first because the list does not say whether repeat hits count.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Follow an in-game armored truck robbery through both the robbery and the escape. Check progress after getting clear; approaching or looting a truck alone does not meet the full condition.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Use a region-by-region sweep to fill gaps on the Leonida map and check which visits advance exploration. The starter gives 52 areas; use the tracker to distinguish credited regions from places you have only passed near.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
Competition kit — tracked count

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Track successful illegal-operation robberies by the operation’s owning gang. The starter lists nine gangs, so prioritize a faction you have not hit yet over repeating another faction’s site.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
Competition kit — tracked count

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Explore Ocean Beach for a drinking interaction with a view and check the award after enjoying the cocktail. The description names the neighborhood without naming a venue; keep a save if the opportunity turns up during a scripted visit.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Check the cocktail prompt on Ocean Beach before leaving any scripted visit.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Keep a save before a sequence involving a vehicle showroom and watch for an opportunity to exit by smashing through. The description does not name the showroom or required vehicle, so check the trophy before leaving the scene.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Save before a showroom sequence and look for an opportunity to smash out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Watch for a visit to the bowling alley at Kolt & Associates and save beforehand if possible. The list hints at follow-through without specifying a score or exact input; check for a bowling prompt before leaving.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Save before a visit to Kolt & Associates and check for a bowling interaction.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Treat the partnership clue as an unresolved trigger and watch for distinctive partner moments during story play. Keep rotating saves before scripted sequences because the list gives no scene, task or retry rule.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Keep rotating saves before partner scenes. The trigger is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make separate saves before explicit choices and check trophy progress after making them. The list gives no qualifying choices or unlock threshold; keep an earlier branch save if you want to revisit a decision.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Save before choices so you can return to the branch point.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Watch for an encounter that gives you a second attempt and keep a save before it if possible. The wording suggests a retry matters, but it does not identify the encounter or prove that a deliberate failure is needed.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Save before a suspected retry sequence. The encounter is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Watch for unusual encounters as you explore and let a strange sequence finish before moving on. The trophy text does not identify the event; keep a prior save if the game appears to offer a one-time encounter.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Stay through unusual encounters and keep an earlier save if they look one-off.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Try the specific melee drive-by action when the game presents a suitable in-game opportunity and check for a knockdown. If your attempt does not register, try again in free roam if the move is available there.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
trophies.warning: Look for a melee drive-by opportunity; if free roam supports it, retry there.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Use the contacts who handle Marked Bills and track the money actually credited from laundering. Aim for $250,000 in proceeds; holding that value in bills is not the same as earning it through the contacts.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Let normal purchases build the shop total and check it before making extra buys to close the gap. The target is $100,000 in spending across shops; the list does not say whether special vendors count.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy each listed garage property, using the ownership list to find the gaps. The kit notes eight garages, so check every garage is owned rather than treating a full vehicle collection as proof.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
Competition kit — tracked count

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Use the Scooter Bros app to submit vehicles and check which registrations go through. Aim for 10 confirmed registrations; finding or owning the vehicles does not itself submit them.
sources: PlayStation 5 trophy list (competition kit; cross-listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles)
